name: Blood Craving restores a share of missing Rage, not of maximum Rage (#649)
contract: Spell.dbc gives Blood Craving 800780 DurationIndex 29 (12000 ms) with effects 0 and 2 = aura 77 (SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_IMMUNITY) with MiscValue 9 (MECHANIC_SILENCE) and 26 (MECHANIC_INTERRUPT), and effect 1 = aura 23 (SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL) at Amplitude 2000 triggering 805985. 805985 effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL_PCT with base 4 -> 5% and effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_ENERGIZE_PCT with MiscValue 1 (POWER_RAGE), MiscValueB 1 and base 14 -> 15%. The Description, the AuraDescription and the reference tooltip all say '15% of your missing Rage', while Spell::EffectEnergizePct pays CalculatePct(GetMaxPower(power), damage), a share of maximum Rage. Rage is stored ten times the displayed value, so maximum Rage is 1000 internal. Starting at 900 internal, the contract pays 15% of the 100 missing, about +15, while a share of maximum pays +150 and saturates the bar. The assertion is therefore that one tick cannot reach the cap. Out-of-combat Rage decay only lowers the value, so it cannot rescue the maximum-Rage behaviour from saturating. Silence 15487 (Mechanic 9) is the immunity probe for the untouched native half.
